THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Split Plate Tropical Chicken Snack Box

Snack Box Series Ep. 7 — the first hot-protein box in the series. Fully cooked fajita chicken + fresh mango + cubed Colby Jack + lightly salted cashews. About 250 cal / 21g protein per box. Make four at once for post-lunch or after-school hunger.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME10 min active — no cook, assembly only
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~250 cal | ~21g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: The photographed chicken is FULLY COOKED. If reheating before packing, heat to 165°F and cool promptly. Never pack warm chicken into a sealed cold-storage box.

Ingredients

PER BOX (yields 1 snack box)

  • 2 oz fully cooked fajita chicken, chopped if needed
  • 3/8 mango, peeled and cut age-appropriately
  • 1 Colby Jack cheese stick, cubed
  • 14g lightly salted cashews (~1/2 label serving, developmentally appropriate ages only)

FOUR-BOX BATCH (recommended)

  • 8 oz fully cooked fajita chicken
  • 1.5 ripe mangoes
  • 4 Colby Jack cheese sticks
  • 56g lightly salted cashews (~2 label servings)

Allergens: dairy, tree nuts.

You want a no-cook 4-box batch that lasts 2 kids × 2 days AND you want a cooked-protein anchor (not the shelf-stable jerky / pepperoni / beef-stick move from Ep. 1-6). Fajita chicken + mango is the tropical hook; Colby Jack + cashews carry the familiar-kid-flavor + crunch. Ep. 7 of the Split Plate Snack Box series — the first hot-protein episode.

Method

  1. 1.SET UP. Set out four divided snack boxes (4-compartment Bento-style — same format as Snack Box Series Ep. 1-6). Fully cooked chicken means no stovetop or oven; the physical chicken package is source of truth if reheating before packing.
  2. 2.CHICKEN. Divide 2 oz fully cooked fajita chicken into one compartment of each box, chopped for the child's chewing ability. Any brand of fully-cooked seasoned chicken works (Soules Kitchen shown). If reheating, heat to 165°F and cool promptly before packing.
  3. 3.MANGO. Peel and cut 1.5 mangoes total across the 4 boxes (3/8 mango each), age-appropriate pieces. The sweet-fresh anchor + the tropical hook. Any ripe mango variety (Ataulfo / Kent / Tommy Atkins) flexes.
  4. 4.COLBY JACK. Cube one Colby Jack cheese stick per box and add to the third compartment. Cube size = 1/2-inch or smaller for young kids. Colby Jack is milder than sharp cheddar — kid-friendly by default.
  5. 5.CASHEWS. Add 14g lightly salted cashews (~1/2 label serving) to the final compartment. FOR KIDS UNDER 4 — omit whole cashews entirely; sub a soft alternative (soft berries, banana slices, or diced apple). Over 4 with good chewing = whole cashews only if supervised. The filmed brand contains cashews + peanut oil and may contain peanuts and other tree nuts.
  6. 6.LID + CHILL. Snap lids on and refrigerate immediately — cooked chicken + fresh mango + cheese all need cold storage. Assembled boxes best within 2 days. For lunchboxes, pack with an ice pack. Add cashews closer to serving if maximum crunch matters (they soften in a sealed compartment after 24 hr).

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Chop chicken to the child's chewing ability. 2 oz per box = the macro anchor — bigger pieces are fine for older kids, smaller dice for young kids.
  • Cut mango age-appropriately. Slippery mango cubes are less of a choking risk than firm spheres, but small kids still need supervised bite-sized pieces.

If something fails

Chicken got sweaty in the sealed box: Packed warm or the box wasn't chilled fast enough. Cool cooked chicken uncovered on a plate for 5-10 min before packing, then refrigerate immediately. If already sweaty, dry-blot with a paper towel before serving — the flavor is fine but the texture reads off.

Mango leaked juice into the chicken compartment: Mango was too ripe or over-packed. Use just-ripe (not overripe) mango and pat cubes dry with a paper towel before placing. Use divided boxes with tall walls between compartments if the leak is a repeat issue.

Kid won't touch the cashews: Age + preference thing. Under 4 they shouldn't have whole nuts anyway. Over 4 and not into them → swap for soft berries / apple slices / banana coins. The fourth compartment is a flex slot.

Colby Jack is too mild for adults stealing a box: Sub sharp cheddar or pepper jack for the adult portion. Cube smaller for adult variety too — small cubes read snackier than a full stick.

Chicken feels dry after 2 days in the fridge: Cooked chicken loses moisture in a sealed compartment. Add a small squeeze of lime or a drizzle of olive oil at serve time, or use it within day 1 for best texture. Reheat gently to 165°F if serving warm — don't microwave the whole assembled box.

Cashews softened by day 2: Nuts + a lidded box + fresh mango moisture = trapped humidity. Add cashews shortly before serving instead of at assembly. Or pack them in a separate mini-container that opens at snack time.

Storage and reheating

Store: Assemble the 4 boxes in one 10-minute pass. Refrigerate immediately — cooked chicken + mango + cheese all need cold storage. Best within 2 days.

Reheat: Don't reheat the assembled box (mango wilts, cheese sweats). If reheating the chicken portion, remove it, heat to 165°F, cool, and re-pack. Serve chilled by default.

Lasts: 2 days max in the fridge. Cashews soften and chicken may dry out after that even when kept cold.

Estimated nutrition

~250 cal | ~21g protein.

About 250 cal / 21g protein per snack box — user-approved headline, not label-verified. Broad component approximation: 2 oz fully cooked fajita chicken (~70 cal / 12g protein) + 3/8 mango (~40 cal / 0.5g protein) + 1 Colby Jack stick (~80 cal / 5g protein) + 14g cashews (~80 cal / 2.5g protein) ≈ 270 cal / 20g protein. Rounds to the ~250 / 21 published headline as a practical allowance for brand + portion variation (chicken brand carries most of the protein weight — Soules Kitchen shown, but any fully-cooked seasoned chicken flexes). Verify against your exact labels before publishing as macro-accurate. Higher protein than Ep. 1-6 because 2 oz cooked chicken outperforms the single-serving jerky / beef-stick / pepperoni anchors used in earlier episodes.

Adult plate | Kid plate

Adult plate

Adult

Adult-friendly batch too — steal a box from the meal-prep stack. ~250 cal / 21g protein reads as a clean parent snack with real protein (thanks to the 2 oz cooked chicken vs the ~7g single-serving-protein anchors in Ep. 1-6). Whole cashews are fine for adults; the kid safety rules below don't apply.

Kid plate

Kid

SAFETY: Whole cashews are choking-hazard textures for young kids. Under 4 = omit whole cashews entirely (use a soft alternative — soft berries, banana slices, or diced apple), and cut chicken + mango + cheese into pieces appropriate for the child's chewing ability. Over 4 with confident chewing + supervision = the photographed textures are fine. Per CDC + AAP choking-prevention guidance. Do NOT label this box school-safe — cashews are a tree nut and school allergen rules vary. Kids can help place components — turns snack prep into low-pressure participation.

  1. 1The photographed chicken is FULLY COOKED. If reheating before packing, heat to 165°F and cool promptly. Never pack warm chicken into a sealed cold-storage box.
  2. 2Chop chicken to the child's chewing ability. 2 oz per box = the macro anchor — bigger pieces are fine for older kids, smaller dice for young kids.
  3. 3Cut mango age-appropriately. Slippery mango cubes are less of a choking risk than firm spheres, but small kids still need supervised bite-sized pieces.

Brands I use

Fully cooked fajita chicken (any brand)
2 oz per box (8 oz total for 4 boxes), chopped if needed.
The protein anchor and the reason this is the first HOT-protein snack box in the series. Photographed brand = Soules Kitchen Fajita Chicken; sub any fully-cooked seasoned chicken (rotisserie, precooked strips, leftover sheet-pan chicken). The physical package is source of truth for reheating and storage. Verify the label for gluten, soy, and any other dietary claims before publishing.
Mango (any ripe variety)
3/8 mango per box (1.5 mangoes total), peeled and cut age-appropriately.
The sweet-fresh anchor + the tropical hook. Ataulfo / Kent / Tommy Atkins all work — Ataulfo is the sweetest and easiest to peel; Kent/Tommy Atkins are more firm and hold in the box longer. Just-ripe (not overripe) reduces juice leakage between compartments.
Colby Jack cheese sticks (any brand)
1 stick per box, cubed. Sargento, Frigo, Kirkland all flex.
Creamy calcium + mild kid-friendly flavor. Milder than sharp cheddar, which makes it a better default for kids. Cube uniformly (1/2-inch or smaller for young kids). Any brand works; the label carries the exact calorie/protein count that anchors the macro estimate.
Lightly salted cashews (any brand)
14g per box (~1/2 label serving). Planters Lightly Salted Cashew Halves & Pieces shown.
Buttery crunch + healthy fat + the fourth-compartment texture pop. Shell-off is easier for kids to handle; measure by the label serving, not by handful. The filmed brand contains cashews + peanut oil and may contain peanuts and other tree nuts — the recipe is honest about that. Whole cashews = choking hazard for kids under 4; use the soft-alternative swap.
